Learn AI in your harness. This site is not the course.

Easy AI Academy is a conversational learning program for nontechnical enterprise employees. Teaching, practice, coaching, and progress stay inside Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Microsoft Copilot Cowork. This page only helps you find the repository and start.

Supported harnesses

Install, then start in chat

Each adapter’s INSTALL.md is the source of truth. Clone commands are the same idea on macOS and Windows; Windows uses PowerShell. Cowork uses a ZIP upload instead of a local clone.

Codex

Foundations: To run

OpenAI Codex discovers personal skills from ~/.codex/skills.

Official Codex page ↗ Setup guide on GitHub Raw INSTALL.md

macOS or Linux

mkdir -p "$HOME/.codex/skills"
git clone https://github.com/jensfossen/ez-ai-academy.git "$HOME/.codex/skills/ai-academy"

Windows PowerShell

Same clone. Use PowerShell paths, not bash.

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$HOME\.codex\skills" | Out-Null
git clone https://github.com/jensfossen/ez-ai-academy.git "$HOME\.codex\skills\ai-academy"

Start in Codex

Use $ai-academy to start a new learning journey.

Cursor

Foundations: Pass

Personal install at ~/.cursor/skills. Cloud Agent Pass recorded 2026-09-07; that run used Markdown fallbacks, not the IDE / menu.

Download Cursor ↗ Setup guide on GitHub Raw INSTALL.md

macOS or Linux

mkdir -p "$HOME/.cursor/skills"
git clone https://github.com/jensfossen/ez-ai-academy.git "$HOME/.cursor/skills/ai-academy"

Windows PowerShell

Same clone. Use PowerShell paths, not bash.

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$HOME\.cursor\skills" | Out-Null
git clone https://github.com/jensfossen/ez-ai-academy.git "$HOME\.cursor\skills\ai-academy"

Start in Cursor

Type / and choose ai-academy

You can also ask naturally to start Easy AI Academy. Evidence: #10, #11, #12.

Microsoft Copilot Cowork

Foundations: To run

Upload the prepared ZIP, or place the extracted skill in OneDrive. macOS and Windows use the same cloud flow.

Official Cowork page ↗ Use Copilot Cowork docs Setup guide on GitHub Raw INSTALL.md

macOS or Windows

  1. Download packages/ai-academy-cowork.zip.
  2. In Cowork, open Customize → Skills.
  3. Select the arrow next to Add, then Upload skill.
  4. Choose the ZIP and finish Cowork’s evaluation flow.

OneDrive alternative: extract so SKILL.md lives at /Documents/Cowork/skills/ai-academy/. Custom skills are currently unavailable on mobile.

Start in Cowork

Start Easy AI Academy as a new learner.

Curriculum scope

What is available, and what is not

This is a maturity map, not a lesson. Open the repository and start a harness session to learn. Prompt Engineering is held until Foundations acceptance clears.

  1. Module 1 · Available

    Foundations — What is an LLM?

    In the repository and taught in-harness. Foundations acceptance is partial: Cursor Pass only (#10, #11, #12). Codex and Microsoft Copilot Cowork are still to run. Claude Code is parked (no usable subscription, #14). Parent tracker: #3.

  2. Module 2 · Held

    Prompt Engineering

    Not ready. Held until the Foundations gate on #3 clears. Do not start this module as a public offer. Issue #4 stays parked.

  3. Later modules · Roadmap

    Context, Agents and Harnesses, Loop Engineering

    Named on the program map only. No public claim that they are implemented or ready to teach.

This page

Privacy and accessibility

Aligned with the enterprise baseline: data minimization first, Markdown-friendly fallbacks, no lesson or gradebook on the website.

No trackers by default

This static page does not load analytics, ads, or social pixels. It does not set cookies or collect learner progress. Hosts you install into have their own logging; the Academy cannot turn that off.

No accounts here

There is no signup, gradebook, or progress dashboard on this site. Portable progress stays in the harness conversation. See enterprise-baseline.md.

Page accessibility

Semantic headings, a skip link, visible keyboard focus, and text that does not rely on color alone. This page does not certify vendor harnesses for WCAG.

Easy AI Academy

Working name. Learning stays in the harness. This page is discovery and setup only.
